title: Explore an integrated energy system
intro: An illustrative tour of electrical and thermal assets considered in integrated energy management and reinforcement-learning research.

solar.label: Solar electricity
solar.detail: Solar generation is a variable electricity source whose availability can inform scheduling decisions.

ev.label: Flexible EV charging
ev.detail: EV charging introduces a flexible electrical demand, subject to connection time, charging power and departure energy requirements.

battery.label: Battery storage
battery.detail: Electrical storage can shift energy across time, subject to state-of-charge, power and efficiency constraints.

heat.label: Thermal management
heat.detail: The heat unit and thermal store illustrate thermal management as an additional energy domain. These are conceptual review elements, not a claimed experimental configuration or a specified heat network.

controller.label: Energy-management controller
controller.detail: The control cabinet represents a supervisory decision layer coordinating assets. This illustration does not execute a trained RL policy.
